_why: Pinned identity of every external weight file this project's evidence is derived from. On 2026-08-31 the shared ~/.cache/huggingface directory was deleted wholesale by another process while the panel was running: the first variants measured cleanly and the rest died with FileNotFoundError on config.json, because a HuggingFace cache is not a project-owned artifact. Record the identity here and assert it before measuring, so a wiped or substituted snapshot fails loudly at preflight instead of silently voiding reproducibility (I9: a number that cannot be reproduced from its named generator is void).
